# Subway Seat for kitty

Colors, cursor, selection, borders, tab bar, title bar, scrollbar and marks, plus the diff kitten's colors. `kitten themes` also lists the flavors once they're in `~/.config/kitty/themes/`. GNOME reports light mode as no-preference, so `no-preference-theme.auto.conf` is Enamel too.

[kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/kitty/) · Needs kitty 0.43+

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/subway-seat.conf
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/subway-seat-tunnel.conf
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/subway-seat-enamel.conf
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/london-moquette.conf
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/london-deep-level.conf
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/london-portland.conf
```

## Follow light and dark

In a shell, in dist/kitty (kitty 0.38+; restart kitty after):

```sh
cp auto/*-theme.auto.conf ~/.config/kitty/   # Walnut for dark, Enamel for light
# Tunnel for dark instead: cp subway-seat-tunnel.conf ~/.config/kitty/dark-theme.auto.conf
```

- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat-enamel.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/london-moquette.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/london-deep-level.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/london-portland.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/subway-seat-diff.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/subway-seat-tunnel-diff.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/subway-seat-enamel-diff.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/london-moquette-diff.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/london-deep-level-diff.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/london-portland-diff.conf`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
